negative_base_fare.justification: Disputed, voided, or refunded transactions; cannot represent valid ride fare.

negative_charge_total.justification: Total charge negative due to reversals/chargebacks.

zero_distance_positive_fare.justification: Trips where vehicle did not move (cancellation/waiting fees, GPS initialization failure). Not representative of point-to-point transit pricing.

zero_or_null_rider_count.justification: Unmetered passenger entries, courier delivery, or driver input oversight. Valid trips with realistic distance and fare should be retained with imputed passenger count.

dropoff_before_pickup.justification: Clock synchronization error or instant trip cancellation resulting in negative or zero duration.

unrealistic_speed_over_80mph.justification: GPS teleportation or inaccurate timestamp entry violating physical urban driving limits.

unknown_or_outside_origin_zone.justification: Trips originating outside NYC jurisdiction or with unmapped zone IDs; exclude from intra-city spatial flow models.

unknown_or_outside_dest_zone.justification: Trips ending outside NYC jurisdiction or unmapped zone IDs.

extreme_fare_over_500.justification: Outlier fares exceeding standard maximum thresholds; severe skewness risk for regression.

extreme_distance_over_100mi.justification: Long-distance inter-city trips outside standard metropolitan fleet operational envelope.

extreme_duration_over_24h.justification: Meter left running overnight or multi-day logging error.
